fusions.name: Sleight of Plate
fusions.desc: Flicks a coin that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Skimmed Off the Top
fusions.desc: A slipped blow that deals 28 damage, ignores resistances and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pie Off the Sill
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 22% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You restore 12 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Cooked Books
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
